headings.rules: DO NOT use Inter or generic sans. Use tracking-tight (-0.025em) and font-medium to font-bold. Limit scale to text-4xl maximum for headers.

body.rules: Highly legible sans-serif for medical data. Size 16px min. Use tracking-normal.

colors.rules: Strict adherence to medical trust blue. Reserve RED (#EF4444) EXCLUSIVELY for Malignant predictions or high-risk alerts. Use GREEN (#10B981) for Benign predictions. Never use pure black.

visual_enhancers.surface_styles: Flat backgrounds with delicate 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), NO default heavy shadows. Only apply soft shadow-sm on hover for interactive elements.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use Phosphor Icons via CDN. Consistent duotone or regular weights.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain overlay for hero/about sections to elevate the 'premium' feel.

grids.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use optical alignment for clinical numbers.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. The 30-feature form MUST be organized into logical grid groups (e.g., Mean, SE, Worst) rather than a single massive vertical list.
layouts.navigation: Fixed sidebar or highly visible top navigation with transparent glassmorphism only if there is a hero background, otherwise solid white.

components.buttons: Rounded-md or pill-shaped. Explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-sky-700 hover:text-white). Do not rely on color inheritance.
components.cards: Neumorphic 'Tactile' variant selectively applied: flat background, 1px sharp border, light ambient shadow.
components.forms: Use structured inputs with clear focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-500). Label typography must be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-wider text-xs).

motion.rules: Use discrete CSS transitions. transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-200. NEVER use 'transition: all'. Apply subtle translateY(-2px) on card hover.

accessibility.contrast: APCA/WCAG AA compliance required. Minimum 4.5:1 ratio for body text. All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Don't rely solely on red/green; include text labels for Benign/Malignant.

media.charts: Use Chart.js for data visualization in Vanilla JS. Format tooltips to be highly readable.

about_hero.description: Abstract AI brain over circuit board, for hero backgrounds or about page.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a Flask + HTML/Vanilla JS application.
Integrate Tailwind CSS via CDN (<script src='https://cdn.tailwindcss.com'></script>) and configure the font families inside the script tag.
Use Chart.js for dashboard statistics and AI confidence rendering.
The 30-feature prediction form must be designed intuitively (Bento grid style or multi-column layout), categorized by Mean, Standard Error, and Worst feature metrics to prevent user fatigue.
Implement clear visual hierarchy: Data freshness and confidence scores should be scan-speed readable.
Apply data-testid to ALL forms, buttons, and prediction result containers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot, brain, etc. for icons. Use proper SVG libraries.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided image URLs.
